_README: TGE distribution config for K613. Total of 'transfers' + 'vestings' MUST equal 100,000,000 * 1e18.
All numeric fields are strings (avoids JSON number-precision issues for 1e26 values).

Time fields are seconds. OZ VestingWalletCliff semantics: durationSeconds = TOTAL vesting from start (cliff included). For team '6mo cliff + 18mo linear after' = 24mo total → durationSeconds = 6+18 = 24mo = 62208000, cliffSeconds = 6mo = 15552000.
transferCount/vestingCount MUST match array lengths (script reads them explicitly).
Replace ALL placeholder addresses (0x...DEAD) with real ones before running.
LM-Rewards-Vault is a Safe (NOT the IncentivesController contract). After distribution, that Safe MUST stake K613 to xK613 and approve PullRewardsTransferStrategy. See OPERATIONS_SOP.md section 1.5b.

transfers.name: POL-Initial-LP
transfers._comment: Receiver MUST be GOVERNANCE_SAFE (the same Safe broadcasting Distribute). Reason: SeedInitialLP.s.sol pulls K613+USDC from broadcaster's address. If POL-Initial-LP goes to a separate Safe, you must also send the paired USDC there and re-route SeedInitialLP from that Safe.
